"Hero MotoCorp Limited (NSE: HEROMOTOCO), headquartered in New Delhi, is the world's largest two-wheeler maker by volume. It was founded in 1984 as the Hero Honda joint venture and took its current name in July 2011. The company makes and sells commuter and premium motorcycles, scooters and VIDA electric scooters, along with spare parts, accessories and related services. It sells mainly in India through an extensive dealer and rural touchpoint network, and also sells in about 50 markets across Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe. It has eight manufacturing facilities and two R&D centres, in India and Germany. Its main strengths are its dominant share of India's entry-level commuter segment (led by the Splendor), a net-cash balance sheet, and a return on equity of about 27%. Its main risks are cyclical rural demand and the shift to electric vehicles. Revenue is about INR 535 billion (TTM) and market capitalization is about INR 1.06 trillion. The company is led by CEO Harsh Chitale and Executive Chairman Pawan Munjal."
